::: {#small-intro}

:::

I have a Master's degree in Applied Physics and Data Science _cum laude_.
I am passionate about modelling the real world to gain meaningful insights into its behaviour.
I have experience in

- computer vision and sensor fusion by designing a custom visual inertial odometry system for multirotor drones,
- embedded systems both the PCB and firmware design,
- control theory using PID loops and Kalman filters,
- machine learning with many hands-on projects as part of the university courses and a timeseries classification model for determining the type of a target from radar tracks,
- deep learning as course projects that cover all classical architectures of neural networks.

I have practical experience with electronics, programming and mechanics already from the age of 14 when I competed in my first [Robotex](https://robotex.international/).
Over the years I built many different robots for competitions such as line following, water rally, folkrace and maze solving.
On one hand, these competitions taught me the basics of everything: programming, control theory, electronics, soldering, mechanical design and 3D printing.
On the other hand, I had many hard lessons on robustness and quality.
The weakest component, be it software or hardware, is always going to break the night before competition :)

In my free time I have enjoyed playing football for my entire life.
In my high-school years I was competing in Estonia's professional level.
But I have always put studying ahead of my football career and so now I play only to keep my mind and body fresh.
Nevertheless, I still value good work ethics, teamwork and an ambitious team around me -- on the pitch we always want to win!
